issues.description: Method name/signature mismatch in ArrayHelpers: the template's ArrayHelpers defines appendElement (appendElement) but the template Stock class (and the solution) call ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray. This inconsistency causes compile failures and will prevent students from building or running the project.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers method name consistent across the template and solution. Either rename the method in the template from appendElement to addElementToArray (preferred, matching the solution and current Stock calls), or change calls in Stock.java to use appendElement. Ensure the method signature and name match across ArrayHelpers and all usages so the project compiles.

issues.description: The helper method for adding an element to an array is referenced with two different names across artifacts: the template's ArrayHelpers declares appendElement (appendElement(T[] array, T element)) while Stock.java calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution uses addElementToArray. This mismatch will prevent successful mapping from the problem tip (which references ArrayHelpers) to the actual template implementation and will cause compilation errors for students using the provided template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from appendElement to addElementToArray, or change the calls in Stock.java to use appendElement. Prefer aligning the template with the solution by renaming ArrayHelpers.appendElement to addElementToArray so all usages (template Stock.java and the provided solution) match and the problem tip clearly maps to an available method.
